basic_info.description: Modern & Stylish! Discover the perfect blend of elegance and comfort in this beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 1-office, 3-bath home with 2,214 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. The gourmet kitchen features a large island, quartz countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, all complemented by sleek engineered hardwood floors throughout. Upstairs, the open dining and family rooms create an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. Downstairs, the large wet-bar and open areas offer incredible flexibility perfect for extended family, guests, a game room, or a home office. Located just minutes from Stonestown Galleria's shopping and dining, H Mart, SF State University, and City College, with convenient access to freeways and MUNI, this home combines modern design with unbeatable convenience. Prime location - don't miss this stunning home!
